dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: One prominent, thick white band with high grayscale contrast visible across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence with sharp, distinct white boundaries along the edges of the dark primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A high-contrast white rectangular/trapezoidal patch visible on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, distinct boundary between the black crown and the greenish-grey mantle, bisected by a white nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible white outer vanes on the lateral rectrices (tail feathers).
